scope: one full-size original workload saved-tensor storage infrastructure check; not an automatic repair or fixed-nine score

result.parameter_count_coverage: Unique live Parameters registered on nn.Module during capture, plus Parameters seen via root forward module.parameters(); sampled at root forwards and optimizer updates. Tied parameters count once; no tensor is retained. Standalone tensors, pre-capture unused modules, and no-root-forward construction failures are not covered. Changing observed counts are incomplete. This is runtime evidence, not authentication against a target that deliberately tampers with hooks.

coverage.module_hooks: Every observed module pre/post forward; direct registered parameters
coverage.internal_autocast: TorchFunctionMode samples autocast and tensor argument/output metadata during forwards
coverage.root_summary: Mixed root forward modes, unknown/unsupported dtypes, errors or limits are unknown
limitations: TorchFunctionMode observes Python-dispatched torch functions; C++/compiled/custom operators may not expose internal autocast or every intermediate dtype.
Metadata records observed precision, not tensor values or full numerical equivalence.
Known compiled wrappers and unregistered or unobserved worker forwards remain unknown.
Metadata observation adds Python overhead; no tensor data or GPU synchronization is added.
Runtime hooks are not authentication against deliberate target tampering.

worker_observers.basis: explicit checkpoint function boundary with actual thread-local operation mode

pairing_capture.reason: captured initialized tensors before training loop
pairing_capture.timing: one initialization hash, excluded from Lab optimizer intervals
pairing_capture.coverage: pinned standalone AST + actual tensors and per-update hooks; cooperative target only; command mode and arbitrary scripts unsupported

parameter_catalog_initialization.scope: Metadata from groups after successful torch.optim.Optimizer.__init__; not custom-subclass completion or an optimizer update. Later step/graph observations may also add identities. No tensor values are read or copied.

optimizer_update_observation.coverage: Process-local Parameter identities and optimizer pre/post hooks; version-counter changes are observations, not numerical equivalence. A grouped update requires one successful complete Tensor.backward and exactly-once coverage of its observable leaf Parameters. Restricted/nested/concurrent graphs are unsupported. Ordinary outer optimizer calls retain the legacy counting contract. This is cooperative instrumentation, not authentication against target tampering.

result.timing_note: Intervals between completed optimizer updates; first includes target setup; pairing initialization hash time excluded, total wall time retains it; module/precision observation overhead remains in measured intervals

execution_capture.basis: instrumented capture owners; not proof of absent uninstrumented processes
